ctf-web.description: Web exploitation techniques: SQLi, XSS, SSTI, SSRF, JWT, auth bypass, file upload, prototype pollution

ctf-pwn.description: Binary exploitation: buffer overflow, ROP, heap, format string, seccomp, kernel

ctf-crypto.description: Cryptography attacks: RSA, AES, ECC, PRNG, ZKP, lattice, LWE

ctf-reverse.description: Reverse engineering: binary analysis, VMs, anti-debug, deobfuscation, dynamic analysis

ctf-forensics.description: Forensics: disk/memory, steganography, network captures, signals, hardware

ctf-osint.description: OSINT: social media, geolocation, DNS, username enumeration, public records

ctf-malware.description: Malware analysis: C2 traffic, PE analysis, sandbox evasion, YARA rules

ctf-misc.description: Miscellaneous: jails, encodings, RF/SDR, esoteric languages, constraint solving

ctf-ai-ml.description: AI/ML attacks: adversarial examples, model extraction, prompt injection, LLM jailbreaking

solve-challenge.description: CTF challenge orchestrator: triage, categorize, and route to specialized skills
